author: ANTON
description: Google Web Search via the public SERP. For production use prefer the Custom Search JSON API (100 free queries/day, then paid) — this browser pack is a best-effort fallback for ad-hoc research. Google fingerprints automation and will serve captchas; missions should run at most a few queries per session.

rate_limits.notes: 3-5 queries per session before captcha becomes likely. For anything higher-volume switch to the Custom Search JSON API.

search.description: Run a Google web search and extract title + snippet for each organic result on the first page.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Result count hint (10, 20, 50 — Google may ignore)

search_news.description: Run a Google News search (tbm=nws) and extract the first page of news results.

steps.description: Extract news result cards (title + source + snippet as innerText)

known_issues: Google renders different HTML for logged-in vs anonymous sessions and for different regions/languages. The selectors target anonymous English (hl=en).
The SERP layout A/B-tests frequently — div.g and div.SoaBEf are the most stable anchors as of 2026 but expect them to drift.
Captcha or 'unusual traffic' pages appear after ~5 automated queries per IP. The executor will see an empty results container and should return a fallback error.

fallback_hints.serp: If div#search is empty but the page loaded, Google likely served a captcha or 'before you continue' consent wall. For robust pipelines migrate to the Custom Search JSON API with a CSE id + API key.
